newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Andes to buy US seafood seller.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes to buy US seafood seller.

text.p: Pacific Andes International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to buy a 60 percent equity interest in National Fish & Seafood Inc (NFS), a U.S.-based seafood processing and distribution company.
The deal would be done through a "new share swap" whereby NFS would issue new shares in exchange for new shares in Pacific Andes valued at US$2 million.
Speaking at a press conference, Pacific Andes managing director Ng Joo Siang said the deal "will pave the way for its entry into the North American market".
Pacific Andes sources, processes and supplies frozen seafood to markets in Europe, the United States, Africa and Asia, particularly China.
NFS's business is confined within the United States, where it has a distribution network of more than 1,600 customers comprising resellers, wholesalers and institutional buyers, Ng said.
